verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a managed streaming service that handles recordings and chat data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no IVS-documented retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-lifecycle controls. The only related item mentions recording to S3 (amazon-ivs-docs-17), which concerns storage destination rather than retention or deletion control by the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
